scenarios.title: Telling a story in the past

items.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
I am looking for a flat.
Could I get the check, please?
We would like to pay together.
Is this the queue for boarding?

items.tr: Arapçada meslek belirtirken "bir" anlamına gelen ayrı bir kelime kullanılmaz — isim doğrudan söylenir.
items.en: When stating a profession in Arabic, there is no separate word for "a/an" — the noun is stated directly.
You want to know their name.
You want to know their origin.

items.tr: İşaret sıfatları isme cinsiyette uyar: eril isimler için هذا, dişil isimler için هذه kullanılır.
items.en: Demonstratives agree in gender with the noun: use هذا for masculine nouns and هذه for feminine nouns.
items.context: سآخذ هذه السترة. / ✗ سآخذ هذا السترة.

items.en: You want to try the jacket.
Do you have a bigger size?
The fitting room is over there.
Do you have this in blue?

items.tr: Saat söylerken asal sayı değil sıra sayısı kullanılır: "الساعة الثالثة" (üçüncü saat) gibi.
items.en: Telling time uses ordinal numbers, not cardinal numbers: "الساعة الثالثة" (the third hour) means three o'clock.
You want to know opening hours.
What time does the store open?
It opens at nine in the morning.

items.tr: "Benim" anlamı için isme doğrudan ـي eki eklenir: أب+ي=أبي.
items.en: To say "my [noun]", attach the suffix ـي directly to the end of the noun: أب+ي=أبي (my father).
My mother works at a hospital.

items.tr: Şimdiki zamanda hava tasviri için "olmak" fiiline gerek yoktur, sıfat doğrudan kullanılır.
items.en: Describing weather in the present needs no "to be" verb — the adjective is used directly: الجو مشمس ("the-weather sunny").
Tomorrow the weather will be warmer.

items.tr: Bir yere gitmek belirtilirken hedef isimden önce إلى ("-e/-a") edatı kullanılır.
items.en: To express a destination, put إلى ("to") before the place noun.
You are at a bus stop.
Which bus goes to the center?
A ticket to the airport, please.
What time does the next train leave?
Where is the nearest metro station?

items.tr: Arapçada emir kipi kime seslenildiğine göre değişir: tek erkeğe اتصل، tek kadına اتصلي، bir gruba اتصلوا — kalabalığa seslenirken çoğul biçim gerekir.
items.en: Arabic commands change form depending on who you address: اتصل (one man), اتصلي (one woman), اتصلوا (a group) — shouting to a crowd for help requires the plural form.

items.tr: "Ben" özneli şimdiki zaman fiilleri fiil köküne eklenen أ ön ekiyle başlar: أستيقظ، أذهب، أنام.
items.en: Present-tense "I" verbs begin with the prefix أ attached to the verb stem: أستيقظ (I wake up), أذهب (I go), أنام (I sleep).
items.context: أستيقظ الساعة السابعة. / ✗ يستيقظ الساعة السابعة.

items.en: When do you go to bed?

items.context: في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع أستيقظ متأخرًا.

items.en: I wake up at seven every day.
I go to work by bus.
I finish my work at five.
In the evening I cook dinner.

items.target: في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع أستيقظ متأخرًا.
items.en: On weekends I wake up late.
Telling a story in the past

items.tr: Geçmiş zamanda "ben" öznesi için fiil sonuna ـتُ eki eklenir: ذهبتُ، شربتُ، عدتُ، نمتُ.
items.en: Past-tense "I" verbs take the suffix ـتُ at the end: ذهبتُ (I went), شربتُ (I drank), عدتُ (I returned), نمتُ (I slept).
items.context: ذهبتُ إلى السوق. / ✗ أنا ذهب إلى السوق.

items.en: What did you do after that?
Yesterday I went to the market.
Ask for the next place or step.
Excuse me, where is the station?
Say what you did not understand.
Describe what you are looking for.
Ask about the cost or condition.
I am looking for a flat.

items.tr: Arapçada geçmişte başlayıp hâlen devam eden bir iş, muzari fiil ve “منذ” ile anlatılabilir. Sayı tamlamasında “ثلاث” ile çoğul “سنوات” kullanılır.

أود أن أقدم لكم نبذة عن مسيرتي المهنية.
أعمل في إدارة المشاريع منذ ثلاث سنوات.
